usedFor: LiveChat holds your customer conversations, and Conversion Chats follows up through “Send Template Message” when “Finished Chat” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A chat that ends can trigger a template follow-up, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: A customer message goes out through your Conversion Chats account, so match each template to the “Finished Chat” event.
